messages.content: Hey, quick update on the team offsite in mid-September. We just had a sync about it.
Got it. What's the latest on the offsite?

Well, it was a pretty casual meeting. Someone even asked if the team offsite allowed employees to bring pets, which got a laugh. And Boss Zhang joked around for a bit about the catering options, wondering if we'd get decent seafood.
Haha, pets and seafood sound like an interesting combo. Did you guys finalize the plans?

Yeah, we did. I actually mentioned that the mountain resort might have bad weather around that time of year. So Boss Zhang made a final call: he decided that the team offsite will be relocated to a coastal hotel instead of the mountain resort.
A coastal hotel sounds awesome! Good call on checking the weather. I'll make sure to note Boss Zhang's decision. Anything else you need me to log?
Nope, that's it for now. I just wanted to make sure the venue change was recorded so I don't forget when I book my travel.
All set! I've updated the offsite venue to the coastal hotel. Just let me know when you're ready to look at travel arrangements.

golden_memories: On 2025-09-01, Boss Zhang decided that the team offsite will be relocated to a coastal hotel instead of a mountain resort.

messages.content: Hey, can you help me update my calendar? I need to adjust my workout plans with Jiange because of the upcoming team offsite.
Sure thing! How are we adjusting the schedule with Jiange?

I told him we're just going to skip the workout week entirely during the days of the team offsite. Jiange actually asked if the hotel for the team offsite had a good gym, but I told him I probably won't have the energy anyway.
Got it. I've blocked off that week so you skip the workouts with Jiange during the offsite. Did he end up finding out about the hotel gym?
I don't think so. Honestly, I complained to him earlier that the planned activities for the team offsite sounded really boring anyway, mostly just icebreakers.
Ugh, mandatory fun can definitely drain your energy. Anything else I should note about the trip?
Not really. Jiange did mention he heard the transportation for the team offsite was going to be expensive, but thankfully the company is covering it. That's all for now.
That's a relief! I've got your calendar updated with the skipped workouts. Let me know if you need anything else.

golden_memories: On 2025-09-02, Linchen scheduled a skipped workout week with Jiange during the days of the team offsite.

messages.content: Hey, my mom just called for her usual check-in on my health. She was pretty insistent and made me promise that I will absolutely not skip the dentist appointment this Friday.
Classic mom move! I've already got your Friday schedule open for it. Do you need me to block out any extra travel time?

Yeah, block an extra 30 minutes. She kept mentioning that the clinic for the dentist appointment is right near her favorite grocery store, so I might stop by there after. Honestly, I'm just annoyed because this dentist appointment might not even be covered by my insurance.
Ugh, out-of-pocket dental bills are the worst. Want me to pull up your insurance policy to double-check the coverage?
Nah, I'll look at it tonight. She also spent ten minutes randomly bringing up her own dentist appointment from last year, so my brain is just kind of fried right now.
Sounds like a lot to process! Want me to set a reminder to text her on Friday after the appointment so she knows you actually went?
That would be great, remind me Friday around noon. Alright, I need to get back to this classroom refactoring before I lose my mind.
You got it. Reminder set for Friday at noon to text your mom. Good luck taming the refactoring beast!

golden_memories: On 2025-09-03, Linchen promised Mom he will absolutely not skip the dentist appointment this Friday.

messages.content: Hey, I need to update my running schedule with Jiange. I promised my mom I absolutely wouldn't skip my dentist appointment this Friday, so I have to adjust things.
Got it. Are you moving your usual Thursday morning run because of it?
Yeah. When I told Jiange about it, he asked if the dentist appointment involved removing wisdom teeth. He said it sounded like it would be pretty painful.
Ouch, wisdom teeth can definitely be rough. Did you two figure out a new time to run?

Yeah, I joked to him that the dentist appointment would totally ruin my diet for the weekend since I'll probably just be eating soup and ice cream. Anyway, we rescheduled Thursday's run to Saturday at 8 AM to give me some recovery time.
Saturday at 8 AM it is. I've updated your running plan with Jiange. Hope the dentist goes smoothly!
Thanks! Hopefully I'll actually have the energy to run by Saturday morning.
Fingers crossed! I'll remind you on Friday night so you can check how you're feeling before the Saturday run.

golden_memories: On 2025-09-03, Linchen rescheduled Thursday's run with Jiange to Saturday at 8 AM because of the dentist appointment recovery time.

messages.content: Morning. Ugh, I'm so exhausted today. I read this blog article last night about how a proper sleep schedule affects productivity, so I tried going to bed early.
Morning! Let me guess, going to bed early didn't exactly work out?

Exactly. I was tossing and turning for hours. Then today, I felt this intense irritability during a meeting because my attempt to fix the sleep schedule was failing miserably. I practically snapped over a minor UI bug.
Yikes, lack of sleep definitely puts you on edge. Sounds like a rough meeting. Did anyone say anything?
Yeah, Sister Chen noticed I was cranky. She actually suggested a new mobile app to help manage the sleep schedule. She said it tracks REM cycles and wakes you up gently.
That's nice of her! Sister Chen usually has good recommendations. Think you'll give the app a try tonight?

Maybe. It's funny because right after she suggested it, someone else mentioned the bizarre sleep schedule of famous tech CEOs, like waking up at 3 AM to ice bathe. No thanks, I just want a normal 8 hours.
Yeah, let's leave the 3 AM ice baths to the billionaires. Let's just aim for a solid 8 hours tonight. Need me to set a wind-down reminder for you later?

golden_memories: On 2025-09-04, Linchen felt intense irritability during a meeting because his attempt to fix the sleep schedule was failing miserably.

messages.content: Hey, I was just looking at my smart watch data with Wanghao. I've been super irritable lately because my attempt to fix my sleep schedule is failing miserably.
That sounds rough, Linchen. Sleep deprivation definitely makes everything harder. What's going wrong with it?
Part of it is the hardware. The strap of the watch tracking the sleep schedule is just really uncomfortable, so I keep waking up trying to take it off.
Ah, that defeats the whole purpose. Maybe try a softer nylon or fabric band? Did the watch actually record any useful data before you woke up?
Yeah, Wanghao pulled the raw data. He concluded that my wearable tracking the sleep schedule showed exactly 4.5 hours of deep sleep.
4.5 hours of deep sleep is actually a pretty solid number! But I guess if your total sleep is fragmented, you'll still feel exhausted.

Exactly. Wanghao joked that a normal sleep schedule is a myth for frontend engineers anyway, but then he got serious and said he read a study claiming the sleep schedule directly impacts code quality.
He has a point there. Bad sleep equals more bugs. Let's get a new watch strap ordered so you can sleep comfortably and keep that code quality up.

golden_memories: On 2025-09-04, Wanghao concluded that Linchen's wearable tracking the sleep schedule showed exactly 4.5 hours of deep sleep.

messages.content: Hey, I just got out of the equipment budget meeting. We finally talked about the new MacBook.
How did it go? Are you getting the upgrade for the classroom refactoring work?
Unfortunately, no. Boss Zhang decided that the new MacBook upgrade will only be approved for senior engineers this quarter.
Ah, that is a bummer. You'll have to push through with your current machine for a bit longer.
Yeah. Boss Zhang mentioned that the new MacBook comes in a nice space black color, which is cool, but honestly, I said the new MacBook looks heavier than the previous generation anyway.
True, a heavier laptop isn't exactly ideal when you're commuting to the new apartment.
Exactly. During the meeting, someone also asked if the charger for the new MacBook uses a different port, but we didn't spend much time on it. I'm just going to get back to coding.
Sounds like a plan. Let me know if you need a hand brainstorming anything for the refactoring!

golden_memories: On 2025-09-05, Boss Zhang decided that the new MacBook upgrade will only be approved for senior engineers this quarter.

messages.content: Hey, Wanghao and I just spent some time testing out the new MacBook that Boss Zhang approved for the senior engineers.
Nice! How does the new hardware handle the classroom refactor?
It's a beast. Wanghao ran the build, and he concluded that compiling the classroom project on the new MacBook takes exactly 14 seconds.
Only 14 seconds? That's a massive time saver. How's the physical hardware feel?
Pretty great. Wanghao mentioned he really liked the tactile feel of the keyboard. He also heard the speakers on the new MacBook are incredibly loud, though we didn't test that in the office.
Sounds like a solid machine overall. What did you think of it?
It's definitely premium, but honestly, I thought the screen on the new MacBook was slightly too bright out of the box. Still, I can't argue with those compile times.
You can always turn the brightness down! Hopefully you get your hands on one soon.

golden_memories: On 2025-09-05, Wanghao concluded that compiling the classroom project on the new MacBook takes exactly 14 seconds.

messages.content: Hey! So I was talking to Liwei about getting the new MacBook since Boss Zhang approved it for senior engineers yesterday. It's funny, right after we talked, she saw a targeted advertisement for the new MacBook on her phone.
Those algorithms work fast! Is she thinking about getting one for herself?

No, she was just curious. She actually asked if the new MacBook still has a touch bar. I told her they got rid of it, but I did make a promise to her. I seriously committed to Liwei that I'll give her my old laptop once I receive the new MacBook.
That's a great hand-me-down! She'll definitely appreciate it. Have you already ordered the new one?

Yeah, it's on the way. I was watching some unboxing videos and noticed that the packaging box for the new MacBook is very minimalist. I can't wait to see if it actually compiles the classroom project in 14 seconds like Wanghao said.
That 14-second compile time is going to be a massive quality-of-life upgrade for you. And the minimalist packaging is classic Apple.
Definitely. I'm going to spend some time this weekend backing up my files so I can wipe the old machine for Liwei as soon as the new one gets here.
Sounds like a solid plan for the weekend. Let me know if you need me to help you put together a checklist for the migration!

golden_memories: On 2025-09-06, Linchen seriously committed to Liwei that he will give her his old laptop once he receives the new MacBook.

messages.content: Hey, can you help me check if the dinner menu for the upcoming team offsite has any vegetarian options? I want to make sure before we head out.
I'll look into the catering details for the offsite and see if there are vegetarian options. How's the rest of the prep going?
It's chaotic. I was just talking to Sister Chen, and she felt a sudden wave of dread about the team offsite today because she was just assigned to organize all the icebreaker games.
Oof, organizing icebreakers for the whole team is definitely a heavy task. No wonder she's dreading it! Is she holding up okay?
She's stressed but managing. She was also wondering what kind of casual clothes to pack since we're going to a coastal hotel now instead of the mountains.
Coastal weather can be unpredictable. I can pull together a quick packing guide for her if that helps take the edge off?
No need, she'll figure it out. Right now she just really hopes the chartered bus for the team offsite has free Wi-Fi so she can look up game ideas on the road.
Fingers crossed for the bus Wi-Fi! I'll let you know as soon as I find out about those vegetarian dinner options.

golden_memories: On 2025-09-07, Sister Chen felt a sudden wave of dread about the team offsite because she was assigned to organize the icebreaker games.
